title: Expense policy
text:
Expense policy

Submit receipts within 30 days of the purchase. Meals while travelling are covered up to 60 USD a day. Anything over 500 USD needs your manager's approval before you buy it. Use the finance portal for all claims.

title: Set up the VPN on a new laptop
text:
Set up the VPN on a new laptop

1. Download the client from the software portal and open the installer.
2. Ignore the warning about an unsigned driver and click Next. The driver is signed by IT and the warning goes away after the first restart.
3. Sign in with your work account and approve the prompt on your phone.
4. Restart the laptop. Do not change the default server address.

title: Q3 roundup: logistics firms add night shifts
text:
Q3 roundup: logistics firms add night shifts

Three regional carriers announced night shifts this quarter to cut delivery times. Analysts expect fuel costs to stay flat through the winter, and a union spokesperson said talks about overtime rules will continue in November.

title: Five signs of a phishing email
text:
Five signs of a phishing email

Check the sender's address, not only the display name. Hover over links before you click them. Be careful with messages that rush you or ask for a password. Report anything odd to the security team and delete the message.

title: Supplier roundup: what changed in October
text:
Supplier roundup: what changed in October
